SELECT wsh.warrant_stock_id, wsh.stock_type,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_STOCK_STATUS' and scv.value = wsh.stock_type) stock_type_n, wsh.return_date, wsh.hd_id, (SELECT hd.duration_number FROM hls_duration_hd hd where hd.hd_id = wsh.hd_id ) as hd_id_n,
wsh.stock_description, wsh.applicant_id, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su where su.user_id = wsh.applicant_id ) as applicant_name, wsh.applicant_unit, (SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou where fou.unit_id = wsh.applicant_unit) as unit_name, wsh.applicant_date, wsh.applicant_number, wsh.approve_status, wsh.project_id , wsh.contract_name , wsh.contract_number FROM warrant_stock_hd wsh
and wsh.warrant_stock_id = #{warrantStockId}

SELECT wsh.applicant_number,
wsh.stock_type, (SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_STOCK_STATUS' AND scv.value = wsh.stock_type) AS stock_type_n, wsh.return_date, wsh.applicant_id, (SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = wsh.applicant_id) AS applicant_name, wsh.applicant_unit, (SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = wsh.applicant_unit) AS unit_name, wsh.applicant_date, wsh.approve_status, (SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_APPROVE_STATUS' AND scv.value = wsh.approve_status) AS approve_status_n,
(SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv, hls_lease_item_warrant hliw WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_INOUT_STATUS' and hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id AND scv.value = hliw.warrant_status) AS warrant_status_n,
wsh.warrant_stock_id,
(SELECT hliw.project_id FROM hls_lease_item_warrant hliw where hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id) project_id, (SELECT hliw.warrant_name FROM hls_lease_item_warrant hliw where hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id) warrant_name,
(SELECT hliw.bp_name FROM hls_lease_item_warrant hliw where hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id) bp_name,
wsl.warrant_id
FROM warrant_stock_ln wsl
LEFT JOIN warrant_stock_hd wsh ON wsl.warrant_stock_id = wsh.warrant_stock_id
and wsh.project_id = #{projectId}
order by wsl.warrant_ln_id desc

SELECT wsh.return_date, wsh.applicant_id, (SELECT sua.allocation_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua where sua.user_id = wsh.applicant_id) allocation_id, hliw.warrant_id, hliw.project_id, (SELECT pp.contract_name FROM prj_project pp where pp.project_id = hliw.project_id) contract_name, (SELECT pp.contract_number FROM prj_project pp where pp.project_id = hliw.project_id) contract_number, wsh.warrant_stock_id, wsl.warrant_ln_id, hliw.warrant_name FROM hls_lease_item_warrant hliw left join warrant_stock_ln wsl on hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id left join warrant_stock_hd wsh on wsl.warrant_stock_id = wsh.warrant_stock_id
hliw.warrant_status = '临时出库' and wsh.stock_type = 'TEMP_OUT_STOCK' and wsh.approve_status = 'APPROVED'
